host.note: Standard-kernel QEMU VM exposes /sys/devices/system/node/node0 + hugepages sysfs (unlike OrbStack VMs) AND exposes AVX/AVX2 via -cpu max (unlike Rosetta), so the x86_64 solana-test-validator binary can run here. x86_64 is TCG-emulated under arm64 — no KVM, too slow for slot cadence.

target.deviation_note: 5 GCC-12 cast conversions + 1 NUMA-fabrication fallback in fd_numa_linux.c. Source-deviation build, NOT clean upstream.

genesis_source.note: Agave 4.3.0 has NO solana-genesis binary (removed in the 4.3 era). solana-test-validator uses the same create_genesis_config code path as a bootstrap validator, so it is used ONLY as a genesis.bin generator (NOT the validator under test). The generated genesis.bin is standard Agave 4.3.0 genesis format, compatible with the Firedancer-embedded Agave (submodule 535ec972, v4.3.0-fd).

goal: Resolve the genesis-load blocker that capped the prior 'started' evidence (20260928T185111Z) at open.rs(25) 'Failed to load genesis_config ... genesis.bin ... NotFound', by obtaining a genesis.bin and testing whether the embedded Agave gets PAST genesis load (bank creation / bank-frozen / leader schedule / gossip).
method: Built solana-diff/agave-tools:4.3.0-amd64 from the prebuilt official Agave v4.3.0 release tarball (download + extract only, NO Rust compile) to obtain solana-test-validator + agave-ledger-tool x86_64 binaries.
Pushed the agave-tools binaries into the qcow2 VM disk at /opt/agave/ via the nbd offline-mount mechanism (privileged debian:bookworm container, qemu-nbd, mount ext4, tar extract).
Pushed fd-start-genesis-probe.sh to the EXACT systemd unit ExecStart path /usr/local/bin/fd-start-probe.sh (the prior run pushed to a path the unit does not invoke).

Booted the VM under QEMU TCG (q35,accel=tcg,-cpu max,-smp 16,-m 65536); -cpu max exposes AVX/AVX2 so the x86_64 solana-test-validator binary runs (Rosetta does NOT expose AVX — verified by an abort in-container earlier).

Probe stages: [0] network up, [1] verify agave-tools, [2] fdctl version, [3] sysfs before, [4] configure init hugetlbfs, [5] configure init sysctl, [6] configure check all, [7] ensure identity key, [8] generate genesis.bin via solana-test-validator --reset --ledger /tmp/gen-ledger (poll up to 75s), place at /var/lib/firedancer/fdvm/ledger/genesis.bin, [9] fdctl run (240s timeout, RUST_BACKTRACE=full).
Captured full serial console to console-genesis.txt.
result: PARTIAL — started (genesis-load blocker RESOLVED; stronger started than prior evidence)

The validator booted 14 tiles with 39 GiB memory, the metric tile served Prometheus on 127.0.0.1:7999, the embedded Agave subprocess spawned, and the process stayed alive the full 240s window (SIGTERM timeout, not a crash). The ledger dir after run shows accounts/ and rocksdb/ created — proof the Agave initialized account/bank processing. This is process liveness WITH machine-readable init-progress evidence past genesis load, not liveness alone.

blockers_resolved.blocker: Genesis-load blocker (prior started evidence, 20260928T185111Z: open.rs(25) 'Failed to load genesis_config ... genesis.bin ... NotFound')
blockers_resolved.root_cause: The image's fdctl has no genesis subcommand (only fddev does, and fddev is not in this image); Agave 4.3.0 has no solana-genesis binary; the prior Jito/Agave genesis-capable images were cleaned up to reclaim disk.
blockers_resolved.fix: Generated a genesis.bin via solana-test-validator (same create_genesis_config code path as a bootstrap validator) from the solana-diff/agave-tools:4.3.0-amd64 image, under QEMU -cpu max (AVX available, unlike Rosetta). Placed the result at /var/lib/firedancer/fdvm/ledger/genesis.bin. The embedded Agave then loaded it and progressed into blockstore/bank-fork init. This is a config/procedure fix, NOT a source deviation.
blockers_resolved.evidence: console-genesis.txt: GENESIS_BIN_READY after 3s; genesis.bin 1462232 bytes; run_agave.c(239) booting agave; blockstore_db.rs(211) + bank_forks_utils.rs(124) NEW log lines; ledger dir shows accounts/ + rocksdb/ created.
